# test/fixtures/isolated-native-campaign.mjs
- Lines: 161 | Kind: tooling fixture (fake Android SDK: generated `adb` Node script, `aapt` shell script, fake APKs, manifests, JDK; spawns the real campaign runner scripts) | Verdict: SIMPLIFY (keep only if the manual native campaign runners stay; otherwise DELETE with them)
- Covers: the host-side contract of the device campaign runners `scripts/test-native-permissions.ts`, `test-native-restart.ts`, `test-calendar-regression.ts`, `test-reminder-*.ts`, `android-workflow-native.ts`: APK pair admission, user creation/cleanup, time-zone restore, instrumentation output parsing (wrong class/method/count/terminal, skipped, duplicate, crash), process-restart PID evidence. Duplicates: `test/android-instrumentation-runner.test.mjs` covers part of the same parsing. Callers/importers: `test/calendar-regression-runner.test.mjs`, `native-campaign-evidence.test.mjs`, `native-permission-runner.test.mjs`, `native-reminder-recovery-runner.test.mjs`, `native-reminder-runner.test.mjs`, `native-restart-runner.test.mjs`, `native-webview-admission.test.mjs` (7 files, ~660 lines). No spec or workflow.

| # | Lines | Pattern | Finding | Change | Risk |

| 1 | 7, 149 | T9 | The runner scripts under test are themselves "tests" in `scripts/` (scripts.md marks them "owner decision: manual device campaign, not run by CI"). They duplicate the registries in the runner scripts and `scripts/android-instrumentation.ts` (CAMPAIGN_RUNNERS) and break on any Java method rename (cross-file-actions row for test-native-restart et al.). | Export the kind→class#method table from `android-instrumentation.ts` (or the runner) and import it here. | Low. |

That is a legacy reader test (D1); delete the kind here with the Java method and the runner case. | Delete the kind and `notesSecureMigrationPhase` gate. | Low. |
| 4 | 56-147 | D8, D9 | A 90-line `adb` emulator written as one template-string Node program with ~50 `else if` branches on joined argv, `${JSON.stringify(...)}` interpolations of host values, and per-kind logic baked in at generation time. | 5 | 13-15, 149, 155 | D9 | Kind is classified four ways (`restartCampaign`, `reminderCampaign`, `permissionCase`, `calendarCampaign`) and each determines script, argv shape and output directory via nested ternaries. | One table `kind → {script, args(root), output(root)}`. | Low. |

| 7 | 123-124 | T8 | Fake recording phase busy-waits with `Atomics.wait` up to 20 s polling the state file. | Keep (it is a condition wait in a child), but cap lower. | Low. |

## Proposed end state
Pending the owner's decision on manual campaigns: one `test/tooling/native-campaign-runners.test.mjs` replacing the 7
importers, using this fixture split into `fake-android-sdk.mjs` (state + adb command table + aapt) and a
kind table imported from `scripts/android-instrumentation.ts`. `notes-secure-migration` removed (D1). If the campaigns
are retired, delete fixture, tests and runner scripts in one commit.
